userInputText: The Impossible Quiz 2 is the sequel to the incredibly challenging trivia quiz game. It's known as the toughest quiz on the internet, and it's back with even trickier questions than before. Get ready for the ultimate challenge! There are a total of 120 questions waiting for you to tackle. Best of luck as you test your knowledge and problem-solving skills!
